character.locked_description: Maya is a 9-year-old South Asian girl with a compact build, warm brown skin, and dark curly hair tied high on her head. She has a round face with thick eyebrows. She wears a teal windbreaker (#2A9D8F), black fingerless gloves, dark denim jeans, and bright orange sneakers. Around her neck hangs a small adjustable wrench on a black lanyard. She sits upright with an alert posture in a lightweight manual wheelchair. The wheelchair features bright orange spoke guards (#F4A261), sleek black push-rims, and a compact black toolkit strapped securely under the seat.
